               (bucket, object_key, checksum_sha256, mime_type, byte_size, original_filename,
                owner_person_id, visibility, status)
           VALUES ('epavillon-prive', $1, repeat('a', 64), 'application/pdf', $2,
                   'programme.pdf', $3, 'private', 'processing')
        RETURNING id
